review_locator: PMCID:PMC3573259, Integrin-mediated regulation of TGF-beta in fibrosis; PMCID:PMC7328133, Integrin alphaVbeta8 adhesion and signaling
primary_title: Integrin alpha(v)beta8-mediated activation of transforming growth factor-beta by perivascular astrocytes: An angiogenic control switch
decision_basis: The reviews identify alphaVbeta8 as an RGD-dependent receptor for latent TGF-beta1/LAP and cite primary work showing alphaVbeta8 binding and activation of latent TGF-beta1 in astrocytes.
limitations_preserved: Preserve latent-complex/LAP and force/metalloproteolytic activation semantics; astrocyte vascular-development comparator only, with no canonical TGFBR relay, SCI receiver, or terminal-TF inference.
